statements.t: “With Phase 1 data for SEP-479 and the initiation a Phase 1 trial of SEP-204 expected in the first quarter of 2027, we are moving closer to realizing our ambition to translate our GPCR expertise into differentiated oral medicines for patients with significant unmet needs.”

risks.t: risks related to clinical development outcomes including unexpected safety or efficacy findings
risks related to the timing of initiating clinical studies and future availability of clinical data
